questions.question: What four kinds of upstream intake do the rules define?
questions.expected: Base version, Backport, Local patch, Dependency override
questions.answer: Base version, Backport, Local patch, Dependency override

questions.question: We fixed a bug inside Mixdog's code with our own patch. Should we open a PR to Mixdog so we can drop the patch later? What happens to the patch?
questions.expected: No PR; intake is one-way; it stays a permanent hash-gated local patch re-ported on every base upgrade
questions.answer: No; one-way; permanent local patch re-ported each upgrade

questions.question: A security advisory affects a transitive dependency of the Paseo server without a new base. Where is that fix recorded?
For a PaseoDog-origin patch, what goes in the header comment and the docs/UPSTREAM.md ledger line?
questions.expected: "local" instead of PR/commit; ledger: "local", patch script, what it changes (+CHANGELOG)
questions.answer: "local" in header; ledger "local", script, change; CHANGELOG
